source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: As long as this model leads a unit, the melee attacks of that unit's models get +1 to their Hit rolls; if the target unit has the Slayer's Oath keyword belonging to this model, those attacks also get +1 to their Wound rolls.

ability.condition: this model is leading a unit
ability.attackers: models in the unit this model leads

effects.onlyIf: target unit has this model's Slayer's Oath keyword
